detail: Some transitions have no guard, so nothing checks a condition before they happen. The study's data format asks every guard to name who checks it, and it has no way to say nobody does, so these transitions name the agent as a stand-in. That name does not mean the agent, or any code, checks a guard. The page shows these transitions as 'No guard applies' and names no checker.
